questions.question: Wait, what did the people say about the time it was?
options: "The time has not yet come to rebuild the house of the Lord."
"The time is now to rebuild the wall of Jerusalem."

"The time of our exile is over, let us build."

key_verse_text: Now, therefore, thus says the Lord of hosts: Consider your ways. You have sown much, and harvested little. You eat, but you never have enough; you drink, but you never have your fill. You clothe yourselves, but no one is warm. And he who earns wages does so to put them into a bag with holes.
